verdict.rationale: Notion documents a first-party Marketplace where reviewed public connections become discoverable to all users. Its integrations directory lists named third-party tools such as GitHub, Loom, Tableau, Mixpanel, Canva, Calendly and Sketch, so the core marketplace capability is clearly delivered, but the 'thousands of tools' scale is not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of the catalog's size (thousands of tools), independent or hands-on corroboration of installing marketplace apps.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
